name: @opensignet/docs
description: Public product, API, and integration documentation for OpenSignet.

scripts.dev: pnpm run build:dependencies && node ../../scripts/sync-brand.ts docs && astro dev
scripts.build: pnpm run build:dependencies && node ../../scripts/sync-brand.ts docs && astro build && node ../../scripts/seo/indexnow.ts prepare-key --site=docs
scripts.preview: pnpm run build && wrangler dev --env preview
scripts.deploy: pnpm run check && node ../../scripts/seo/indexnow.ts verify --site=docs --production && wrangler deploy && node ../../scripts/seo/indexnow.ts submit --site=docs --production
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build:dependencies && node ../../scripts/sync-brand.ts docs && astro check
scripts.test: pnpm run build:dependencies && node ../../scripts/sync-brand.ts docs && node --test "test/*.test.ts"
scripts.check: pnpm run validate:content && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run build && pnpm run validate:output
